description: Thirty synthetic previews, eight empirical cash-rate previews, 21 hedged-index previews and 22 unhedged-index previews with explicit provenance and offline aggregate validation.

conventions.data: Synthetic, fixed sample; not observed market performance
conventions.returns: Simple returns for backtesting; panel statistics use the recorded reporting preset
conventions.rebalance_timing: Units held between quarter-end rebalancings; close-t weights apply over [t,t+1]
conventions.cost_basis: Portfolio NAVs net of 10 bp per unit traded; synthetic benchmark has no costs

conventions.data: Dedicated seeded model-layer teaching fixture, preserved unchanged
conventions.returns: Monthly additive log returns; annualised means multiply by 12
conventions.cost_basis: Gross and net model NAVs; 0.15% annual proportional log-return cost drag
conventions.rate_basis: Raw benchmark returns; no risk-free-rate subtraction
conventions.feature_basis: Full factorial two-feature experiment; Shapley averages

conventions.data: Synthetic, fixed sample without quirks; not observed market performance
conventions.returns: Stated per exhibit: monthly log or simple, quarterly regime grid, daily targeting
conventions.annualisation: af = 12 monthly, 4 quarterly, 252 daily as set by qis frequency maps
conventions.rate_basis: Zero cash rate except the FX exhibits: synthetic 3.5% USD and 3.0% CHF annual quotes for CIP only; no cash subtraction
conventions.cost_basis: Gross returns except the fee exhibit: 2% management, 20% performance fee
conventions.teaching_constructions: Volatility regimes scale SEQ_US returns in the targeting exhibit; the truncating bootstrap draw comes from the example; FX exhibits define CHF per USD as normalised SBD_TSY raised to 1.5
conventions.fx_hedging: 36-month EWMA log-return FX volatility/beta from 2005; performance from 31Dec2010 to 31Dec2025; monthly hedge and CIP quote lagged one month; [0,1] clip; simple total NAVs; geometric p.a./monthly-log-vol Sharpe with rf=0; no additional trading costs
conventions.holdings_alpha_beta: Monthly unit-held backtests with predetermined target switches, zero cash/funding rates and costs; EWMA-demeaned instrument log-return beta with 12-return warm-up and no beta prior; native-date weights; alpha = 12 times 12-span EWMA of NAV log return minus one-month-lagged holdings beta times benchmark log return, reset from 31Dec2010; NAV regression shown only for comparison
conventions.checks: Each exhibit has an independent closed-form or numpy check of its plotted values

numerical_review.method: Reconstructed from rate_start_pa and rate_end_pa; scipy.stats.linregress and direct monthly error moments
numerical_review.preview_refit_source: Same QIS source export and environment as the complete bundle; content fingerprint and dependency versions in published provenance
numerical_review.original_runtime_metadata: Original 2 October exploratory plotting runtime was not captured; published previews are the independently verified refit

conventions.data: Observed JPM cash-index simple returns and annual short-rate quotes; frozen 2 October 2026 sample, not synthetic.
conventions.returns: Simple monthly cash estimates. Estimate = rate/12; no compounding within month.
conventions.timing: Lag0=end quote; lag1=previous month-end quote; midpoint=their mean. Hedge carry lag remains1.
conventions.regression: x=JPM cash return; y=estimated cash return; intercept included; common nonmissing support per currency.
conventions.errors: Estimate minus JPM; bias, MAE and RMSE in monthly basis points.
conventions.reproduction: Complete batch preserves reviewed PNG bytes and regenerates aggregate tables; does not refit licensed observations. Explicit refit requires private CSV.
conventions.source: Original study used qis.plot_scatter; new preview layout refit through qis source identified by bundle fingerprint.

conventions.data: Observed raw CMA index returns, not backfilled or nowcast. September 2026 cutoff; partial October excluded.
conventions.returns: Monthly simple total returns; no extra costs or cash subtraction; provider index tax/dividend conventions retained.
conventions.hedge: 100% monthly opening-principal hedge; contemporaneous spot move; prior month-end annual quotes and actual interval days / 365.
conventions.regression: x=observed hedge return, y=QIS synthetic return; OLS with intercept; identical complete recent support per pair.
conventions.errors: QIS minus observed: monthly bp MAE/RMSE; annual bp sample TE with af=12 and ddof=1; annual geometric return difference.
conventions.scope: 18 USD bond comparisons, one matched US equity CHF hedge, two regional equity diagnostics. Aggregate world USD-to-USD hedge not replicated.
conventions.reproduction: Offline batch preserves reviewed current-kernel aggregates and PNGs; --returns-csv recomputes both windows through the typed QIS API from supplied private panels.

numerical_review.method: QIS payoff checked independently in return and NAV-level space; OLS checked with SciPy; QIS sample TE and geometric returns checked independently; both FX paths and non-circular anchors verified
numerical_review.private_recheck_scope: Recent 69-month derived panel for both FX inputs only; full-history aggregates retain original independent review
numerical_review.deliberate_defects: Omitted asset/FX interaction and lagged realised FX each rejected for all 22 pairs

preview_configuration.panels: Two QIS scatterplots with OLS and intercept plus cumulative relative return
preview_configuration.visual_review: All 22 source PNGs reviewed on 2 October 2026

parameters.WMR_acquisition: Official WMCO and WMCD tickers returned unknown/invalid security on this terminal; no independently observed WMR history was available.

conventions.data: Native daily PX_LAST total-return index levels fetched through Bloomberg; complete monthly returns; September 2026 cutoff; partial October excluded.
conventions.returns: Monthly simple provider total returns; hedge_ratio=0; is_excess_returns=False; no carry, costs or cash deduction.
conventions.existing_FX: Supplied generic spot close panel; reference currency per USD cross; contemporaneous realised monthly FX move.
conventions.diagnostic_FX: Normalised unhedged index ratio from a different family; tested pair never supplies its own anchor; not independently observed WMR or executable FX.
conventions.regression: x=observed unhedged monthly return, y=QIS reconstruction; OLS with intercept; 69 common monthly observations.
conventions.errors: QIS minus observed; sample TE annualised with af=12 and ddof=1; MAE/RMSE monthly bp; geometric-return differences annual bp.
conventions.full_history: Complete common support of index pair, supplied FX panel and held-out anchor; not necessarily all history of the target alone.
conventions.reproduction: Offline batch preserves reviewed PNGs and checks aggregates. Explicit private command rechecks recent derived inputs only; no vendor acquisition or full-history refit.

conventions.data: Frozen synthetic sample, not observed investment performance
conventions.returns: Business-day log returns for volatility estimates; simple returns for unit backtests
conventions.timing: Month-end target weights trade one business day later; units drift between trades
conventions.reporting: Monthly preset; panels label their grid and window; annualisation follows the QIS frequency convention
conventions.rate_basis: Reports: non-excess PA Sharpe with no cash rate. Performance table: constant 3% annual cash rate, ME volatility and QE regression
conventions.cost_basis: Report NAVs net of 10 bp per unit traded; Brinson effects gross of realised trading costs
conventions.attribution: Native-date BHB allocation, Frongello-linked; interaction assigned 100% to selection; benchmark regime shading
conventions.cash: Displayed average weights include residual cash from NAV less marked holdings, lagged to each return period; initial cash and cost funding included; no cash interest
